verdict.reason: Ownership and bounded admission are suitable proposed patterns; neither inspected upstream code nor a library choice proves Studio production behavior.

canonical_baseline.future_spec: Root-owned v02.207 candidate; not treated as current authority

source_evidence.observed: Composite mutation transaction, record-user privacy, per-component/property revision granularity, CRDT attribution and kernel job backpressure are already normative.
HBR-SWARM requires concurrent agent/operator edits, bounded cancellation, lease recovery and no starvation/deadlock; HBR-PRIV requires resource scope and negative boundary proof.
create_job waits for startup recovery, persists AiJob then emits a best-effort FR event. This function is not proof of fair byte/job admission.

SessionHandle retains teardown completion, owned concurrency permit and committed-memory charge until terminal/teardown. Existing owner uses cancellation-safe memory and lifetime-spawn reservations, concurrency/cold-start permits, duplicate admission, breaker and budget checks. Reuse these owner patterns; they are not Studio worker implementation.

Standalone append persists an event; bulk/event-pair helpers contain transactions. None of these inspected paths demonstrates a future composite Studio document mutation plus revision/projection transaction.
loom_account calls api::authority::authorize_request for exact resource/action/capability and maps failures to constant denial; reuse the authorization boundary rather than an engine-local ACL.
Arc<Session> COW, revision bump, history, transport_requests Vec and journal Vec. Snapshot technique is reusable; buffers are not bounded swarm admission.

std::sync::mpsc::channel; callback fill invokes drain; drain loops try_recv until empty, handles session swap and allocates channel-format buffers; cpal callback invokes fill. Meter try_lock is present, but does not bound callback drain work.
render collects a per-block work Vec, may resize scratch and dispatches native >=4 strips through rayon par_iter_mut. This is unsuitable as an unmodified strict real-time adoption boundary.
Headless command run uses spawn_blocking then locks shared Session for g.execute. Do not transplant this automation host into the Studio commit path.
Parallel row-band perimeter computation creates per-fold Vec accumulators sized by feature count. Admission estimate must cover scratch multiplied by concurrency, not only input pixel size.

primary_library_research.name: tokio bounded mpsc
primary_library_research.selected: Bounded non-RT mailbox implementation candidate behind existing job/actor ports
primary_library_research.limitations: Capacity is message count. send Ok is not delivery or commit. select cancellation can discard the owned message; reserve retains caller payload until admission but cancellation loses FIFO position. Outstanding permits affect channel closure. Pending send futures and allocations need their own bounds.

primary_library_research.name: tower load_shed
primary_library_research.selected: Optional typed pre-admission overload boundary around an existing Service
primary_library_research.limitations: Reports ready while recording inner readiness and rejects call when not ready. No durable acceptance, byte accounting, scheduling fairness or cancel protocol; layer ordering must not hide overload behind an unbounded outer buffer.

primary_library_research.name: arc-swap
primary_library_research.selected: Conditional snapshot publication candidate on non-RT reader paths
primary_library_research.limitations: 1.9 source documents prior weak orderings; pin reviewed current version, do not reproduce atomics. Guards have limited fast slots and should not cross async yields. rcu retries closure; no I/O, ledger append or side effect in it. store drops replaced value, so destruction/reclamation cost needs an owned non-RT retirement path. Pointer CAS is not database revision or document merge semantics.

primary_library_research.name: rtrb SPSC
primary_library_research.selected: Conditional fixed-capacity control-to-audio and audio-to-control boundary with exactly one producer and one consumer
primary_library_research.limitations: Payload allocation/destruction can violate RT properties despite queue implementation. Full returns value, not overwrite. Consumer abandonment must be checked on control side. Swarm producers funnel through a bounded owner; this is not MPMC and no universal lock-free/wait-free engine claim follows.

INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: SoundCraft playback drain is unbounded per callback and uses std channel; mix render allocates and may wait for Rayon strip completion. No RT acceptance claim made.

INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.method: Canonical spec versus proposed actor granularity
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: STU-DS-163 and STU-SHL-221 require disjoint component/property success; blanket document expected-revision rejection would regress those obligations.

INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.method: EventLedger transaction body versus composite Studio requirement
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: Standalone append and event-pair transaction cannot prove atomicity of externally executed Studio patch.

INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.method: Primary current library implementation and limitations inspection
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: Bounded mpsc, LoadShed, ArcSwap and SPSC have different boundaries; none is a complete swarm scheduler or durable mutation authority.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Document patch commits, process dies before append/receipt, retry reapplies patch or replay loses committed edit
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Single typed SurrealDB transaction performs authorization-bound revision preconditions, patch, event, idempotency claim, stream/projection head. Acknowledged commit is recoverable even after actor death; snapshot publication is after commit. Timeout is outcome-unknown until canonical idempotency reconciliation, not canceled mutation.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Kill only validator-owned worker at each transaction/ack boundary; reopen namespace and query idempotency/event/document state, prove zero partial mutations and one event for successful receipt.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: A 32-slot mailbox has 32 enormous decoded images plus thousands of blocked producers retaining input; process exhausts memory
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Bound producers/request body bytes before decoding; weighted bytes cover input, expanded image/audio geometry, scratch per worker, result and retained snapshot generations. Unknown expansion uses incremental chunk admission or refuses before expansion. Slot admission alone is insufficient; never spawn a task just to wait for a permit.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Flood mixed size compressed images/audio while holding consumers; report admitted/rejected bytes, resident high-water and lease count; no allocation is outside the measured budget except separately bounded baseline.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Session edits arrive continuously; callback drain never reaches rendering, or format swap allocates on callback; four strips invoke parallel Rayon work
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Prepare graph/buffers/plugins off callback; fixed SPSC descriptors, per-block maximum command count, preallocated emergency stop mechanism, bounded retired-object handoff. Do not call general Rayon, Tokio, database, logger, allocator or mutable document lock from RT callback. Failed enqueue retains prior valid graph and reports control-side typed outcome.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Instrument allocation/free, callback work and deadline misses under edit+export+plugin pressure on actual device; device-loss and queue-full cases require audible/recorded-output inspection. No audio SLO passed here.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Commit actor uses document revision for every write; second disjoint property/component is rejected or stale full snapshot overwrites first
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Actor serializes authority commits, not broad conflict domains. Carry target revision vector and semantic patches; validate only impacted component/property/dependency records, assemble on latest snapshot after successful transaction, preserve CRDT actor causality. Structural edits declare the broader read/write set explicitly.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Two models and operator edit disjoint and same targets; both disjoint writes survive, same precondition produces one commit and one deterministic conflict with permitted metadata.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Queue full blocks worker result delivery while actor waits for that worker; cancel is behind saturated queue; lease cannot release
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Actor dispatches and returns to receive; no actor await on work that must reply to its own mailbox. Reserve completion/control slots at admission; cancel/deadline uses separately bounded reserved capacity and monotone cancellation epoch, with a per-turn service quota so control floods cannot starve commits. Release on every terminal path.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Saturate request/results/control independently and combined, inject blocked worker, inspect wait-for graph; cancel service bound holds, queues drain and all budgets return to baseline.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: One actor floods FIFO permits, repeatedly cancels/retries or giant requests keep small independent documents waiting
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Existing scheduler owner supplies bounded per-actor/project/document admission quotas and cost-aware fair turns with aging. Charge incremental work and bound each non-preemptible chunk. A request larger than total budget is typed too-large, never infinite wait. Admission freshness and lease epoch are rechecked at dispatch.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Heavy/light actors, continuous hot-document traffic and cancellation churn; record per-actor admitted/completed/rejected counts and maximum eligible service delay against declared policy, no starvation claim from FIFO alone.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Principal B reuses A's idempotency key or revoked worker exports pixels after access changed; overload diagnostics reveal document existence
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Bind identity to principal/account, project/resource, action, canonical payload hash and target preconditions; mismatched key is conflict, never reused result. Authorize admission, dispatch, transaction and result delivery. Derived scope intersects every source. Queue and metrics visibility is broker-scoped; denied paths use non-disclosing shapes, including retry/pressure errors.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Authenticated record-user cross-account and same-project private resources; revoke while queued, during render and between commit/ack; no bytes, receipts, thumbnails, actor names or restricted existence leak.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Old immutable snapshots and GPU textures survive queue completion and evade released byte permits
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Separate request, execution, snapshot-retention and device leases; transfer charge with ownership, release only after last retained owner/device fence. Cap pinned generations/read leases; do not invalidate an active reader's memory unsafely. When cap is reached reject/pause new optional previews, preserving committed state and established readers.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Hold old readers while publishing new snapshots; memory plateau and visible pressure must match cap; induce device loss, stale completion, and allocation failure, then verify CPU fallback/typed unsupported route and lease recovery.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: Latest-wins preview coalescing accidentally drops committed edit, final export or cancellation receipt
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Coalescing applies only to explicitly replaceable uncommitted work keyed by principal+resource+operation+generation. Return superseded outcome to every displaced caller. Durable edits have committed receipt or typed precommit rejection; exports remain job identities with explicit cancellation. Never report mailbox send as accepted durable mutation.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Mix scrubs, paint/undo, proposal promotion and final export under full queue; reconcile all request IDs with one permitted terminal outcome and compare final authoritative revision/history.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.case: FilmCraft headless adapter submits blocking tasks which then serialize the entire Session under Mutex
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.fix: Adopt deterministic computational leaves through typed ports and owned snapshot/proposal inputs; replace upstream automation host with Handshake-owned bounded admission/actor commit flow. Do not add a second MCP server, queue or DB; do not translate shared document Mutex into ArcSwap CAS mutation loops.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_check: Source boundary scan plus real command invocation through host verifies no upstream automation host/runtime is pulled into engine execution.

proposed_contract.ownership: Document commit/proposal actor owns mutable authoring state and commit order. Compute workers consume immutable revisioned snapshots and return proposals/artifacts. Existing logical JobRuntime owns scheduling and execution; ResourceBroker owns authorization; EventLedger/SurrealDB owns authority; Argus owns observation. No new server/database/independent scheduler.
proposed_contract.host_mapping_limit: No literal Rust JobRuntime or ResourceBroker struct found in scoped WP012 searches. Actual inspected host reuse points are create_job/workflows startup recovery, swarm coordinator reservations, api::authority::authorize_request and surreal event_ledger. Resolve final typed port implementation mapping during foundations; logical owner labels are not new crate declarations.
admission_order: Bound transport envelope and pending callers
Classify replaceability and compute bounded expansion estimate
Acquire fair owner-issued slot/byte/device budget atomically or release partial acquisition before waiting
Publish admitted request with deadline/revision/lease epoch/idempotency metadata
Dispatch bounded worker after freshness and authorization recheck

overload_outcomes.preview: Typed superseded or pressure rejection; keep last valid preview and label its revision/staleness
overload_outcomes.edit: Typed pressure rejection before commit with caller work retained; durable commit returns original receipt on authorized identical retry
overload_outcomes.export: Job identity, bounded queue, explicit queued/running/cancel-requested/terminal outcomes; no silent replacement
overload_outcomes.audio_input_overrun: Bounded lost-frame counter and marked discontinuity; do not label damaged recording complete
overload_outcomes.audio_output_underrun: Defined silence/last-safe bounded fallback, non-RT diagnostic and recovery; no callback blocking
overload_outcomes.stop: Reserved control path; bounded epoch/flag observation without queue-full starvation

commit_order: Validate impacted target preconditions and current authorization
Apply patch+EventLedger+idempotency+heads in one authority transaction
Publish immutable snapshot carrying committed event/revision
Return receipt; if acknowledgment fails reconcile canonical idempotency on retry
proposed_contract.stale_results: Proposal whose target/dependency revisions changed receives conflict/stale result; optional preview can be discarded with superseded outcome. CRDT causal operation merge is distinct from CAS record commit. No auto-retry with a refreshed revision unless operation-specific semantics and policy permit it.
proposed_contract.cancellation: Before commit may terminate without mutation. After committed transaction cancellation cannot erase edit; return committed receipt and cancel only pending compute/delivery work as allowed. Long compute cooperatively checks between bounded chunks. Native codec/plugin non-cooperation has explicit bounded host/process isolation policy and typed unavailable cancellation; no imaginary abort guarantee.
proposed_contract.shutdown: Close admission; retain accepted durable requests/outcomes; release or expire unused reservations, service reserved completion/cancel lane, drain or checkpoint within declared deadline, reconcile outcome-unknown transactions on restart. Persistent recovery state lives in existing authority records, not a second queue DB. Lease fencing blocks stale worker completions after actor restart.
proposed_contract.foundations_first: Each crate/module foundation executes its applicable narrow capability with a real consumer before dependent feature implementation. Pure math/validation leaves remain host-independent and demonstrate bounded deterministic input/output plus meaningful negative cases. Integration adapters/harnesses demonstrate snapshot-compute-proposal flow and bounded admission/cancel through existing host ports where applicable; do not pull DB/scheduler dependencies into every leaf. Manifest, no-op trait, empty registry or generated capability declaration alone cannot unlock feature work. Exact minimal per-module operations remain in the independently authored adoption review; this report does not replace that mapping.
proposed_contract.diagnostics: Scoped counters: pending callers/slots/bytes/old generations, running workers/device budget, age/service delay, cancellation latency, lease epochs, stale/conflict/replay outcomes, RT under/overruns. Argus/model command and manual explain overload/recovery; FR/internal_diagnostics/Palmistry attribution must not expose other resource scopes. Counters/threshold declarations are not proof.

COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: If SurrealDB transaction integration is replaced by event_ledger::append after an external patch, STU-SDB-004 replay and crash atomicity break even if actor sequencing is correct.
If SoundCraft AudioState::drain130 is retained unchanged, continuously arriving commands can occupy callback fill256 before audio production; bounded control-to-RT drain must replace it.
If target revision vector is replaced by one document revision, STU-DS-163 and STU-SHL-221 disjoint same-document writes cannot both satisfy acceptance.
If swarm CommittedMemoryReservation::Drop209 pattern is omitted in proposed admission rollback, canceled partial acquisition can retain budget and starve later actors.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: Read callback consumer AudioState::fill/drain against producer std channel construction; found no per-block command limit.
Read FilmCraft automation caller against Session lock execute; found broad owned-session mutation host unsuitable for reuse.
Read EventLedger append transaction scope against canonical Studio atomic mutation clause; composite guarantee remains unimplemented/unproven.
Read record-granular spec against per-document actor proposal; required explicit separation of serialization and conflict domain.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Static counterexample: canceled mpsc send future can drop payload; no durable send acknowledgment assumption accepted.
Static counterexample: outstanding mpsc permit delays drain termination; shutdown requires permit lifetime cap.
Static counterexample: same key across principals or changed content must not disclose original receipt; canonical scope binding required.
Static counterexample: revoked queued result cannot use admission-time grants for output delivery.
